title: US senators warn Apple not to buy Chinese memory chips to escape the shortage

content_html:
Apple wants to buy cheap memory chips from China to ease a shortage. That shortage is already pushing up the price of its gadgets. A bipartisan group of US senators has just told Tim Cook not to.

The senators wrote to Cook, urging Apple to drop any plan to buy Chinese memory. The two suppliers are ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) and Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC). Their chips would leave the world’s most valuable company reliant on a US adversary for critical parts, Bloomberg reported.

The letter was led by Indiana Republican Jim Banks and New York Democrat Chuck Schumer, an unusually cross-party pairing. Both CXMT and YMTC sit on a recently updated Pentagon list of firms believed to support China’s military. YMTC is also on a US Commerce Department trade blacklist.

“This short-sighted move would be a mistake,” the senators wrote. It would leave Apple “dependent on critical supplies from a firm the United States government has formally designated as a Chinese military company.”

Why Apple is even considering it

The context is a brutal squeeze on memory. Prices have soared on unprecedented demand from AI chipmakers such as Nvidia. In June, Apple raised prices across its Macs, iPads, home devices and the Vision Pro, blaming the shortage.

Cheaper Chinese memory would help. Apple has spent months lobbying Washington for clearance. It has sought the blessing of senior Trump officials, including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, and has been testing CXMT’s chips for its China-market devices.

CXMT is at the centre of it, fresh off a blockbuster Shanghai IPO. It is not named in US export regulations, though it runs advanced chipmaking facilities. YMTC is more clearly restricted. Apple’s earlier attempt to use it, in 2022, collapsed under Washington’s opposition.

The China-only loophole, and the jobs

Apple’s pitch is that the Chinese memory would only go into devices sold in China. The senators do not buy it. Once a part clears Apple’s qualification, they wrote, “extending it worldwide is a single procurement decision away.”

They also punctured the savings argument, citing analysis that CXMT’s pricing is sometimes higher than its rivals’. And they asked what Apple has handed over to qualify the chips, given US rules that require a licence to send technical blueprints to Chinese factories.

There is a home-state interest, too. Many of the signers come from states where Micron and SK Hynix are spending billions on new memory plants. Micron alone plans $250bn across New York, Idaho and Virginia. Cheap Chinese memory, the senators fear, could undercut those Chips-Act-backed projects.

An awkward moment

The timing is delicate. Apple this week became only the second company to reach a $5tn valuation, and Cook has cultivated a close relationship with President Trump. The row also lands weeks before a planned Trump-Xi summit in the US, where chip export controls are on the agenda.

The senators want Apple to commit by 21 August to keep CXMT and YMTC memory out of its products entirely. Apple did not immediately comment. For now, it is caught between a shortage it cannot fix quickly and a Washington that will not let it take the cheap way out.

content_html_zh:
苹果希望从中国购买廉价存储芯片以缓解短缺问题。 这种短缺已经推高了其产品的价格。 一个由美国参议员组成的两党团体刚刚告诉蒂姆·库克不要这样做。

参议员们写信给库克，敦促苹果放弃任何购买中国内存的计划。 这两家供应商是长鑫存储科技（CXMT）和长江存储科技（YMTC）。 据彭博社报道，他们的芯片将使世界上最有价值的公司在关键部件上依赖于美国对手。

这封信由印第安纳州共和党人吉姆·班克斯和纽约州民主党人查克·舒默领导，这是一对不同寻常的跨党派组合。 长鑫存储和长江存储均位于五角大楼最近更新的据信支持中国军方的公司名单中。 长江存储也被列入美国商务部贸易黑名单。

“这种短视的举动将是一个错误，”参议员们写道。 这将使苹果公司“依赖于美国政府正式指定为中国军事公司的一家公司的关键供应。”

为什么苹果甚至在考虑它

上下文对记忆的残酷挤压。 由于英伟达等人工智能芯片制造商前所未有的需求，价格飙升。 6 月，苹果将 Mac、iPad、家用设备和 Vision Pro 的价格提高，并将其归咎于短缺。

更便宜的中国内存会有所帮助。 苹果公司花了几个月的时间游说华盛顿批准。 它已寻求包括财政部长斯科特·贝森特在内的特朗普高级官员的支持，并一直在测试长鑫存储用于其中国市场设备的芯片。

长鑫存储位于其中的中心，刚刚在上海进行了轰动一时的IPO。 尽管它拥有先进的芯片制造设施，但美国出口法规中并未提及该公司的名字。 长江存储受到更明确的限制。 苹果公司曾于 2022 年尝试使用它，但在华盛顿的反对下失败了。

仅限中国的漏洞和就业机会

苹果公司的宣传是，中国制造的内存只会用于在中国销售的设备。 参议员们并不买账。 他们写道，一旦某个部件通过了苹果公司的资格认证，“只需一个采购决定就可以将其扩展到全球范围内。”

他们还驳斥了节省开支的论点，援引分析称，长鑫存储的定价有时高于竞争对手。 他们还询问，鉴于美国规定向中国工厂发送技术蓝图需要获得许可，苹果公司已经提交了哪些材料来验证这些芯片的资格。

也有母国利益。 许多签署者来自美光和 SK 海力士斥资数十亿美元建设新内存工厂的州。 仅美光公司就计划在纽约、爱达荷州和弗吉尼亚州投资 2500 亿美元。 参议员们担心，廉价的中国内存可能会削弱那些芯片法案支持的项目。

尴尬的时刻

时机很微妙。 苹果本周成为第二家估值达到 5 万亿美元的公司，库克与特朗普总统建立了密切的关系。 这场争吵还发生在特朗普与习近平计划在美国举行峰会的几周前，芯片出口管制已被提上议程。

参议员们希望苹果公司承诺在 8 月 21 日之前将长鑫存储和长江存储内存完全排除在其产品之外。 苹果没有立即发表评论。 目前，它陷入了无法迅速解决的短缺和华盛顿不会让它走廉价出路之间的困境。
